scenarios.name: Close and restore the drawing browser from its tab area

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is active in the MCAD Software
its model browser is docked on the left
the user selects the browser tab's close control
the drawing occupies the space previously used by the browser
a plus control remains at the upper left of the workspace
the user opens the plus control
the panel list offers Model Browser
the browser returns to the left
it displays the drawing resources and sheet tree
